question: In a certain code language, if EXTRNSIC is written as CIXESNRT, then how will LEFTWING be written in the same code language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

EXTRNSIC is written as CIXESNRT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff2ffe7763e56120db04799ac320215cc60bf27f6e2f56ad0da4c1c6c6847745.png] 

Similarly,

'**LEFTWING**' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e039de2ef9372446ddfcb5cc593d06529a43b50a9fc36d9f0da24d175ab5ae4d.png] 

Hence, 'LEFTWING' is coded as "**GNELIWTF**".
